{{Quote|If my lady wishes to appear beautiful, then she must be patient.|Muura, chiding Vestara Khai for her restlessness|<ref name="Omen" />}}
'''Muura''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] and an [[Aide/Legends|attendant]] to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Sith Tyro|Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] in [[41 ABY]]. Muura was talented in the making of the ceremonial [[vor'shandi]] markings, as well as elegantly braiding [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. She used these talents to lavishly decorate Vestara the [[Standard day/Legends|morning]] that the Tyro traveled to the [[Circle Chambers]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] for a meeting with the [[Circle of Lords]], the planet's ruling council. Vestara was then [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticed]] to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea|Rhea]] and moved to live in the [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]]. Muura was subsequently dismissed from the Khai [[Khai estate|household]], as her services were no longer needed.

==Biography==
{{Quote|There, you look lovely, mistress!|Muura happily praising Sith Tyro Vestara Khai|<ref name="Omen" />}}
[[File:Vestara.jpg|thumb|right|140px|Muura was an attendant of Vestara Khai (pictured), and adorned her with vor'shandi markings]]
Muura was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] from the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She was a maidservant of the [[Khai family]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]],<ref name="Omen" /> in [[41 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''dates the section of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' that features Muura to [[41 ABY]].</ref> She often attended to [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]], the only daughter of [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Lahka Khai]]. On the morning that Vestara was to travel to the [[Circle Chambers]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] for a meeting with the [[Circle of Lords]], the planet's governing council, Muura prepared Vestara with [[vor'shandi]] markings&mdash;which were made from the nectar of the [[S'rai plant]]&mdash;particularly of the [[dalsa flower]], and intricately braided her hair. Afterward, Muura was no longer needed as his daughter's attendant, as Vestara was chosen to be the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea|Rhea]], and would have to live in the [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]].<ref name="Omen" /> Gavar informed Muura that the family no longer had need of her at their [[Khai estate|estate]], and he gave her clothing and food to last several [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Gavar also told a few of his friends that Muura had become available for work elsewhere.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Muura had the soft purple skin and lilting accent of her [[Species/Legends|species]]. Muura was accustomed to Vestara's unhappiness at the marring scar on her face, and she fawned over the Tyro, praising her beauty even though Vestara herself thought that Muura was more attractive. Muura was skilled in the artistry of vor'shandi markings, beautiful designs painted onto members of the Tribe for special ceremonies. She was also highly dexterous, as she was able to weave her mistress' long brown hair into intricate braids.<ref name="Omen" />

Muura was confused by Gavar's sadness in the house as his daughter left, and when he informed her that her services would no longer be needed; but she knew better than to ask for a reference upon her dismissal.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
Muura was created by author [[Christie Golden]] for her novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Omen" />
